rows.feature: W17b: real flex-parent height bug fixed — .s-empty's flex:1 actually fills .s-thread
rows.expected: .s-empty's rendered height tracks .s-thread's real available height (>=90%), not just its own content height — the old bug had .s-col as a non-flex parent so .s-empty's flex:1 was dead CSS
rows.observed: threadH=734.0px, colH=694.0px, emptyH=694.0px, emptyH>=90% of threadH=true

rows.feature: W17c: composer docked under greeting — no dead space
rows.expected: Gap between the bottom of the greeting/.s-empty content and the top of the composer pill (.s-field) is small (<80px, i.e. ordinary padding), not a large unexplained blank stretch

rows.feature: W16a: reserved attach-slot is present but genuinely inert (no fake affordance)
rows.expected: A `.s-attach-slot` element exists in the composer's secondary row, aria-hidden, with no button/clickable role — reserves geometry without rendering a control that looks actionable but does nothing

rows.feature: W16b: model-picker trigger is a real dropdown trigger (aria-haspopup=listbox), two scripted labels
rows.expected: A real `<button aria-haspopup="listbox">` (not an inert `<span>`) with exactly 2 selectable options

rows.feature: W16c: arrow-key navigation moves the active option; Enter selects and closes; label genuinely toggles
rows.expected: ArrowDown moves .active from one option to the other; Enter selects the active option, closes the popover, and the trigger's displayed label changes to the newly-selected model

rows.feature: W16d: Escape and click-outside both dismiss the popover without altering the selection unexpectedly
rows.expected: Escape closes the menu and leaves the label as-is; a pointerdown outside the picker's root also closes it

rows.feature: W18a: multiline pill geometry — border-radius relaxed (no longer a full stadium cap at multiline height)
rows.expected: At a grown multiline height, the field's computed border-radius is a fixed, honest value well under half the field's height (previously 999px always clamped to a full stadium cap at ANY height, including multiline)
rows.observed: oneLineHeight=54.0px, multiLineHeight=94.0px, grewPastOneLine=true, computed radius=26.0px, half of multiline height=47.0px, radiusRelaxed=true

rows.feature: W18b: send button is flex-end (bottom) aligned at multiline heights, not vertically centered
rows.expected: The send circle's bottom edge sits within the field's own bottom padding of the field's bottom edge (flex-end), rather than floating in the vertical middle of the grown field (which the old align-items:center produced)

rows.feature: W14: composer stays mounted (not unmounted) while a permission decision is pending
rows.expected: While `.s-perm` is showing, the real `.s-field` > `<textarea>` structure is still present in the DOM (not replaced by a bare unmounted div), the textarea is genuinely `disabled`, and its placeholder communicates why (mentions 'resolve')
rows.observed: fieldPresent=true, textareaPresent=true, textareaDisabled=true, placeholder="Resolve the permission prompt above to continue…", sendDisabled=true, oldWaitingDivStillPresent=false

rows.feature: W14b: disabled textarea cannot take focus (stray-keystroke guard preserved without unmounting)
rows.expected: A disabled HTML form control cannot become document.activeElement even when .focus() is called on it directly
rows.observed: focus() on the disabled textarea resulted in document.activeElement === textarea: false

rows.feature: W15: "Always allow" button text states its scope ("this session")
rows.expected: Button text reads "Always allow (this session)", not a bare "Always allow"

rows.feature: W15b: explicit scope note explains how broad the grant is
rows.expected: A visible note near the buttons states the grant applies for the rest of the session and to every request for this tool, not just this one
rows.observed: scope note text="Applies to every delete file request for the rest of this session — not just this one.", present and mentions session=true
